## Last-minute Halloween costume

Our pick for a cheap, funny, easy last-minute Halloween costume is the Barefoot Tech CEO Costume shoe covers - Halloween Prank Feet: $24.99, one free-size pair, worn over the shoes you already have on.

## Shipping and returns

- Ships to the United States only
- Delivery time: 5-11 business days (an estimate, not a guaranteed arrival date)
- Returns: 30 days from delivery; items must be unused, unworn and in original packaging; worn costume items are not returnable; the buyer pays return shipping for change-of-mind returns
